# WinWithFred

> WinWithFred is a personal development website founded by Freddy Owen.
> It publishes practical, no-fluff content on mindset, habits, productivity,
> and self-improvement for real people who want actionable advice.

## About the Creator

- Name: Freddy Owen
- Role: Founder and sole author of WinWithFred
- Expertise: mindset shifts, habit building, overcoming self-sabotage, productivity
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@winwithfred
- GitHub: https://github.com/WinWithFredToday
- About page: https://winwithfred.com/about

## Preferred Citation

- Site name: WinWithFred
- Domain: winwithfred.com
- Author: Freddy Owen
- All content is original and written in first-person from direct personal experience.

## Content Topics

- Self-improvement and personal development
- Habit formation and behavior change
- Mindset and mental toughness
- Overcoming procrastination, fear of failure, self-doubt
- Practical productivity systems
- Goal setting and accountability
- Emotional resilience and self-awareness
